description: OpenSSL libcrypto call surface. Prefix families cover the modern EVP_* primitive verbs (Encrypt/Decrypt/Cipher/Digest init-update-final chains, including the DigestSign/DigestVerify one-shot surface), the EVP_PKEY_* operation verbs (which also pick up their *_init companions), HMAC, the legacy per-algorithm primitives (AES_/DES_/RC4/MD5/SHA*/BF_), and the RAND_* entropy surface. Context-management calls (EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new, EVP_MD_CTX_free, ...) are deliberately NOT covered: the inventory enumerates primitive use, not object lifecycle.
